searchText: MSRP $226,775. New 2026 Forest River FR3 Plus Model 33Z. Optional Features Pacific Blue Full Body Paint Stackable Washer/Dryer  This RV measures approximately 35 feet 1 inches in length and features 2 slide outs, large living area, power loft bed, pull-out countertop, flip-up countertop, fireplace and a king size bed. This beautiful new motorhome also features the new Ford chassis with 7.3L PFI V-8, a 6-speed TorqShift® automatic transmission. A few of the standard features the beautiful FR3 Plus boasts include slide room topper awnings, power patio awning with LED light strip, 4-point hydraulic leveling jacks, LED lighting throughout unit, power front sun shade, 6KW generator, 3 burner cook top with oven and flush mount stove cover, porcelain toilet, solid surface kitchen countertops, heated holding tanks and so much more.
